cases.desc: Normalisation of an image equal to the ImageNet channel means
cases.expected: Output is zero in every channel (within 1e-5)

cases.desc: Output shapes of the multimodal network for a batch of 3 images
cases.expected: Logits 3 x 5 and severity of length 3

cases.desc: Severity score for extreme inputs (very large and very small activations)
cases.expected: Always between 1 and 5

cases.desc: Class probabilities of one prediction
cases.expected: Non-negative and sum to 1 (within 1e-5)

cases.desc: Grad-CAM map for one image
cases.expected: Same size as the input, values in [0, 1], no NaN

cases.desc: Additivity of the exact Shapley values
cases.expected: Base value plus the four values equals the prediction (within 1e-6)

cases.desc: Min-Max scaled weather profiles held by the application
cases.expected: All 16 profiles lie in [0, 1] for every feature

cases.desc: Explanation text for a prediction
cases.expected: Names the predicted class, gives the probability, and states that the weather is an approximation that does not prove a cause

cases.desc: Explanation text when no weather variable raises the probability
cases.expected: Text states that no variable raised the probability and has no lowering clause error

cases.desc: Handling of images in other colour modes (greyscale, RGBA, palette)
cases.expected: Each is converted and diagnosed without error

cases.desc: Handling of very small (16 x 16) and very large (3000 x 2000) images
cases.expected: Both are resized and diagnosed without error

cases.desc: Every region and season combination (4 x 4 = 16) for one image
cases.expected: All 16 profiles are found and give a valid prediction

cases.desc: Repeatability: the same image and profile twice
cases.expected: Identical class probabilities

cases.desc: Unknown region or season passed to the diagnosis function
cases.expected: Rejected with an error and not answered silently

cases.desc: Loading of the saved model, scaling limits, weather profiles and background set from the results folder
cases.expected: Bundle contains the model in evaluation mode, 16 profiles and a background of weather vectors

cases.desc: Start of the Streamlit server and first page
cases.expected: Server answers the health check; page shows the title and the prototype warning

cases.desc: Upload of one leaf photograph through the browser
cases.expected: Prediction heading, severity or severity note, heatmap, two charts and the statement appear

cases.desc: Agreement between the browser result and a direct call of the diagnosis function for the same image and profile
cases.expected: Same predicted class and the same probability in the statement

cases.desc: Change of region and season after an upload
cases.expected: Page recomputes and still shows a complete result

cases.desc: Upload of every sample leaf photograph
cases.expected: Every upload gives a complete result without an error message

cases.desc: Upload of a file type that is not allowed (text file)
cases.expected: File is refused by the uploader and no diagnosis is shown

cases.desc: Upload of a corrupted image file (valid extension, damaged content)
cases.expected: A clear message is shown and the page does not crash with a stack trace
